'''Asuncion Karganilla-Raymundo''' is a Filipino biologist and Professor Emeritus for Microbiology at the [[University of the Philippines Los Baños College of Agriculture]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.ibs.uplb.edu.ph/64-about-joomla/ibs-professor-emeriti/122-dr-asuncion-k-raymundo-professor-emeritus-for-microbiology-and-biotechnology|title=Dr. Asuncion K. Raymundo, Professor Emeritus for Microbiology and Biotechnology|website=www.ibs.uplb.edu.ph|access-date=2019-05-10}}</ref>

==Biography==
Raymundo was born on August 15, 1946. She got a bachelor's degree in [[soil microbiology]] from the University of the Philippines Los Baños College of Agriculture and got her Master's in phytobacteriology from the [[University of Hawaii]].<ref name=":0" /> She then returned to the University of the Philippines Los Baños in 1972, becoming faculty of the new College of Science and Humanities.<ref name=":0" /> Raymundo later obtained her Ph.D. from the [[University of Illinois]] and became a postdoctoral researcher in [[molecular genetics]] at the [[International Rice Research Institute]]. She has also worked at [[Monash University|Monash]], [[Osaka University|Osaka]] and [[Kansas State University|Kansas State]] universities. In 1987 she was awarded an Outstanding Teacher Award and received [[Presidential Diploma of Merit]] a year later. She trained over 130 graduate and undergraduate students. During her teachings she and her class studied hypersensitivity and pathogenicity gene of a microorganism called [[Xanthomonas oryzae]], and [[Ralstonia solanacearum]] a bacterial [[wilting|wilt]] which was found on [[solanaceae|solanaceous]] crops and [[banana]]s.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|url=http://www.philsciletters.org/December%202008/Asuncion%20Raymundo%20Feature%20PSL%202008.pdf|title=Asuncion K. Raymundo: Peering into microbes and pioneering molecular microbiology in the Philippines|author=Edwin N. Camaya and Evanjill Alcantara|publisher=[[Philippine Science Letters]]|volume=1|issue=1|page=2|access-date=2013-09-25|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130927173712/http://www.philsciletters.org/December%202008/Asuncion%20Raymundo%20Feature%20PSL%202008.pdf|archive-date=2013-09-27|url-status=dead}}</ref> In 2001 she became [[Pantas Award]]ee.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Profiles: ASUNCION K. RAYMUNDO |url=https://spheres.dost.gov.ph/profiles?start=180 |access-date=2024-06-10 |website=spheres.dost.gov.ph}}</ref> Currently she is a dean of the [[College of Arts and Sciences]] in the [[University of the Philippines]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.nast.ph/index.php?option=com_profile&id=29&view=details&template=nast3&Itemid=20 |title=Raymundo, Asuncion K. |accessdate=September 25, 2013 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130927090643/http://www.nast.ph/index.php?option=com_profile&id=29&view=details&template=nast3&Itemid=20 |archivedate=September 27, 2013 |url-status=dead }}</ref> She is a member of the [[Philippine Society for Microbiology]] and is a President in the same field at the [[American Society for Microbiology|American Society]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.famousfilipino.com/content/view/113/118/|title=Asuncion Raymundo|accessdate=September 25, 2013}}</ref>
